g.text: Six stored native lag checkpoints; discard first half. Colors/seed counts match the circumference summary.
Model clocks and forcing laws differ. These finite-window curves describe the activity-vector heading, not a cell-migration autocorrelation.
Use with its paired coverage sheet: weak-resultant endpoints are excluded from direction; sparse estimates remain unavailable. Connecting segments guide the eye.
